title: ScreamSeq Windows workspace requests
description: Workspace presentation, inspected context and application shortcut preferences only; no song revision, musical Undo or playback stop. These methods accept neither expectedRevision nor expectedContext. Editor placement retains existing native fields and drafts. Inspection and audio qualification modes store named layouts and shortcuts in memory only.

shortcut.description: Assign or clear one application command binding. The complete candidate must be valid and free of duplicate or prefix conflicts before publication. Unknown fields, unknown IDs, repeated modifiers and invalid keys reject atomically. Returns data.command and canonical data.keys; changed remains false because it describes song history, not preference changes.

command.description: Opaque ID from workspace.commands.get, currently windows.command.<integer>. IDs are Windows-specific; do not derive them from menu labels or share them with macOS.

keys.description: Zero strokes clears the global binding; one binds a shortcut; two to four form a sequence. A nonempty custom sequence must start with Ctrl or Alt, except that the exact defaults array for this command restores its trusted default including unmodified bindings. Escape cannot be a continuation. Local editor/text input still has first refusal. Canonical output is lowercase with ctrl+, alt+, shift+ in that order. Sequences expire after 1500 ms or a context/focus change.

items.description: Case-insensitive optional Ctrl/Alt/Shift modifiers and one printable ASCII key other than +, or a named key: space, tab, return, escape, backspace, delete, insert, home, end, left, right, up, down, pageup, pagedown, plus, f1 through f24. Aliases enter, esc, pgup and pgdn normalize to canonical names. Modifier names cannot repeat. Windows-reserved Ctrl+Alt+Delete, Ctrl+Escape, Alt+Tab and Alt+Escape also reject with extra modifiers, in any sequence position.

inspectorPanel.description: Read-only contextual notes/sample inspector. Placement alone does not request focus. These panels support right/hide only.

follow.description: True unpins and inspects the current edit cursor.

return.description: True returns to the panel's original opening position with playback-follow off and focuses the tracker.

editorPanel.description: Retained automation, instrument/envelope, Graph curve or precise-note row editor. preciseNotes is independent of the read-only notes inspector. Graph curve and preciseNotes prefer secondary; other editors prefer float. Fixed regions fall back to compact tabs, retaining HWNDs, raw fields, capture and desired placement.

pinned.description: False requests following the relevant cursor or selected routing source. A pending operation or retained draft can defer target refresh; it does not discard that draft.

focus.description: True opens/selects the retained editor and focuses it. A hidden editor uses its last non-hidden placement, initially float for automation/instruments or secondary for Graph curve/precise notes. False or omitted preserves valid existing focus where possible; in compact mode the focused Pattern, inspector or Main host may remain selected and the newly placed native editor hidden. Explicit bottom replacement of Main selects the native editor.

follow.description: True unpins and requests a guarded refresh from the current cursor or selected routing source. Retained drafts and pending work keep their captured target/revision.

return.description: True returns to the initial opening position using stable pattern identity, with playback-follow off and tracker focus. Rejects if that document or pattern is unavailable. Precise notes also resolves its opening track by stable identity and rejects a deleted track.

savedName.description: Default Custom. UTF-8 Unicode name; no controls or leading/trailing whitespace. Up to 24 names, case sensitive.

layout.description: Presentation only. Editors V4 records automation, instruments, graphCurve and preciseNotes. V2/V3 hide new owners except a legacy bottom Notes selection migrates to preciseNotes bottom. V4 has no editable Main notes identity. A seven-field lowerEditor notes alias reveals the sole owner at its existing placement, or bottom when hidden; otherwise missing editors retains current placements. Restore stages missing owners and validates document, source, raw generation, focus and layout before adoption; existing owners retain drafts/pins/targets. Built-in Connected and Graph editing deliberately hide preciseNotes without destroying it.
